page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8y.large is a general-purpose server instance powered by an arm64-based Alibaba Yitian YiTian710 processor operating at a clock speed of 2.75 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 2 dedicated physical cores and 2 vCPUs with 1 thread per core. Memory allocation is set at 8.0 GB of system RAM, yielding a 4.0 GB memory-per-core ratio. The CPU cache architecture provides 64 KB of L1d cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 64 MB of L3 cache. This server type includes hardware-accelerated AES cryptography instructions but lacks x86-specific vector extensions such as AVX, AVX-512, and AMX. The instance has no bundled local storage and includes a baseline network throughput of 2 Gbps without complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Performance benchmark evaluations show varied results across execution types. Single-threaded performance demonstrates moderate capabilities, with a stress-ng single-core score of 1818.78 and a gzip compression throughput of 28.38 GB/sec, both falling within average benchmark bands. Conversely, multi-core and memory-heavy operations show lower output. The multi-core stress-ng metric scores 3601.68, and uncached large-block memory read bandwidth measures 38.93 GB/sec, placing overall multi-core scalability and memory bandwidth in lower performance percentiles. Database execution tests record 2163.98 operations in Passmark database testing and 3.45 million SET operations per second in Redis.

The ecs.g8y.large profile delivers a cost-efficient entry point for ARM-native architectures requiring dedicated CPU resources without shared-core throttling. Its standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM balance supports light infrastructure services, basic web serving with 3.62 GB/sec static web throughput, and non-intensive background application tasks that do not depend on specialized vector instruction sets or high memory bandwidth.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8y.large is a general-purpose cloud instance powered by a 2.75 GHz ARM-based Alibaba Yitian YiTian710 processor with 2 dedicated vCPUs and 2 physical cores. It features 8.0 GB of system memory, 64 MB of L3 cache, AES encryption support, and a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps, while omitting local storage and GPU accelerators. In benchmark evaluations, single-threaded CPU routines like stress-ng single-core execution and gzip compression perform in average tiers, whereas multi-core scalability and memory bandwidth remain in lower percentiles. The absence of x86 vector extensions limits execution to ARM-compatible software stacks. This server profile is suited for lightweight general-purpose workloads, basic web serving, and small-scale application services requiring a balanced vCPU-to-RAM ratio on ARM architecture.
